teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: age, year, old, job, work, teacher, doctor, engineer, manager, live, city, retired

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
age, year, old, job, work, teacher, doctor, engineer, manager, live, city, retired
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How old is your brother? (asking age)
• He is thirty years old (stating age)
• What does she do? (asking job)
• She works in a hospital (stating workplace)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Word stress in multi-syllable job titles ('engineer', 'manager') and numbers.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Word stress in multi-syllable job titles ('engineer', 'manager') and numbers.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Present Simple of 'be' & 'work' + Age Expressions (He is 40 years old, She works as a teacher)

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Present Simple of 'be' & 'work' + Age Expressions (He is 40 years old, She works as a teacher)
Controlled Practice:
My mother works in a school. What is her job?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: How old is your father?
B: My father is fifty years old. He is a doctor.
A: And what does your mother do?
B: She is a teacher and works in a school.
Listen to Sarah describing her parents' jobs and note down their ages and workplaces.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Practice speaking with your partner: I can state the age, occupation, and residence of my family members.
